gaps.sentence: Unless it ___ , the match will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'unless' = if…not; present simple after time/condition words.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ a lovely evening that nobody wanted to leave.
gaps.explanation: 'Such a lovely evening that …' — 'so' would go directly before an adjective.

gaps.sentence: He's got a ___ of stamps from every country he's visited.
gaps.explanation: Noun form: collection (a group of collected items).

gaps.sentence: You'd better hurry, ___ you'll miss the flight.
gaps.explanation: 'Otherwise' = if you do not, then this will happen.

gaps.sentence: Her success was largely ___ to her coach.
gaps.explanation: 'be down to somebody/something' = be caused by.

gaps.sentence: He ran so fast that we lost ___ of him.
gaps.explanation: 'lose sight of somebody' = no longer see them.

gaps.sentence: I'd rather walk than ___ the bus.
gaps.explanation: 'would rather do A than do B' — both bare infinitives.

gaps.sentence: He kept ___ even though everyone had left.
